reviewer_tool: Gemini native app, existing project conversation
record_type: Manually transcribed audit summary, not experiment output
findings: Separate fixed handwritten baseline performance from learned program quality.
The custom 30-operator suite is not the complete official KernelBench benchmark.
The three fresh test operators share structural families with training operators; do not claim unseen-family out-of-distribution generalization.
Report exact pass counts, paired per-operator outcomes, single-seed scope and actual SFT/GRPO optimizer counts.
The SFT-only control is essential; base-to-hybrid changes cannot establish an RL-only gain.
Both tracks intentionally use the original pre-SFT base as KL reference. The anchor differs from a post-SFT reference and must be documented.
CPU-vocabulary 7B readiness peak is a one-example fit measurement, not the peak or quality result of the complete study.
Static source policy and child-process checks are empirical development guards, not formal equivalence or OS security proofs.
Frame production uses as potential applications; no deployed inference or energy saving has been measured.
resolution: Retain the frozen schedule, explicitly document the original-base KL anchor, shared-family test scope and readiness/full-study distinction in the manuscript and website. No metrics inferred from the audit.
